; Use the native ungrouped adjustment loader and native tool components.
AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/toolbar/qml/SettingsMenu.qml
    TRAVERSE ToolbarTool#root
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT {
            Item {
                id: nativeReaderMenuLayoutReady
                Component.onCompleted: console.info("native reader menu layout ready 2026102602")
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
    TRAVERSE ToolbarTool#root > Component#settingsComponent > ColumnLayout#content > Repeater > ToolLoader#adjustmentToolLoader
        REPLACE active WITH { active: true }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/DocumentPageSlider.qml
    TRAVERSE PageSlider#pageSlider
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT {
            Row {
                id: nativeReaderJumpShortcuts
                objectName: "nativeReaderJumpShortcuts"
                anchors.left: parent.left
                anchors.leftMargin: ArkControls.Values.spacing.xlarge
                anchors.bottom: parent.top
                anchors.bottomMargin: 28
                height: 88
                spacing: 24
                visible: !pageSlider.pageThumbnailVisible
                Component.onCompleted: console.info("native reader jump shortcuts ready 2026102605")

                ArkControls.Button {
                    id: nativeReaderJumpTocButton
                    objectName: "nativeReaderJumpTocButton"
                    text: "目录"
                    iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/list"
                    width: 224
                    height: 88
                    focusPolicy: Qt.NoFocus
                    background: Rectangle { color: "white"; radius: 18 }
                    contentItem: Item {
                        Row {
                            anchors.centerIn: parent
                            spacing: 12
                            ArkControls.Icon {
                                source: "qrc:/ark/icons/list"
                                size: 40
                                color: "black"
                                anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                            }
                            Text {
                                text: "目录"
                                font.pixelSize: 26
                                color: "black"
                                anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    visible: {
                        const view = pageSlider.documentView;
                        return !!view && !!view.rmtoolTableOfContentsAvailable && typeof view.rmtoolOpenTableOfContents === "function";
                    }
                    onClicked: {
                        const view = pageSlider.documentView;
                        if (!view || typeof view.rmtoolOpenTableOfContents !== "function") return;
                        pageSlider.pageThumbnailVisible = false;
                        pageSlider.visible = false;
                        view.rmtoolOpenTableOfContents();
                    }
                }

                ArkControls.Button {
                    id: nativeReaderJumpOverviewButton
                    objectName: "nativeReaderJumpOverviewButton"
                    text: "页面概览"
                    iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/page_overview"
                    width: 224
                    height: 88
                    focusPolicy: Qt.NoFocus
                    background: Rectangle { color: "white"; radius: 18 }
                    contentItem: Item {
                        Row {
                            anchors.centerIn: parent
                            spacing: 12
                            ArkControls.Icon {
                                source: "qrc:/ark/icons/page_overview"
                                size: 40
                                color: "black"
                                anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                            }
                            Text {
                                text: "页面概览"
                                font.pixelSize: 26
                                color: "black"
                                anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    visible: {
                        const view = pageSlider.documentView;
                        return !!view && !!view.document && typeof view.openOverview === "function";
                    }
                    onClicked: {
                        const view = pageSlider.documentView;
                        if (!view || typeof view.openOverview !== "function") return;
                        pageSlider.pageThumbnailVisible = false;
                        pageSlider.visible = false;
                        view.openOverview();
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/DocumentView.qml
    TRAVERSE FocusScope#root > Item#_uiContainer > Rectangle#pageSliderBackground
        REPLACE anchors.topMargin WITH { anchors.topMargin: -148 }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/Pages.qml
    TRAVERSE Background#pages
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT {
            // NativeReaderTocOriginBegin
            property bool nativeReaderOverviewJustOpened: false
            property bool nativeReaderTocReturnsToBook: false

            function nativeReaderFinishToc() {
                const returnToBook = nativeReaderTocReturnsToBook;
                nativeReaderTocReturnsToBook = false;
                tableOfContentsLoader.active = false;
                if (returnToBook) documentView.closeOverview();
            }

            Timer {
                id: nativeReaderOverviewEntryTimer
                interval: 0
                onTriggered: pages.nativeReaderOverviewJustOpened = false
            }
            Connections {
                target: pages
                function onVisibleChanged() {
                    pages.nativeReaderOverviewJustOpened = pages.visible;
                    pages.nativeReaderTocReturnsToBook = false;
                    if (pages.visible) nativeReaderOverviewEntryTimer.restart();
                    else nativeReaderOverviewEntryTimer.stop();
                }
                function onDocumentChanged() {
                    pages.nativeReaderOverviewJustOpened = false;
                    pages.nativeReaderTocReturnsToBook = false;
                    nativeReaderOverviewEntryTimer.stop();
                }
            }
            // NativeReaderTocOriginEnd
        }
    END TRAVERSE
    TRAVERSE Background#pages > Loader#tableOfContentsLoader
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT {
            onActiveChanged: {
                // NativeReaderTocActivationBegin
                if (active) {
                    pages.nativeReaderTocReturnsToBook = pages.nativeReaderOverviewJustOpened;
                    pages.nativeReaderOverviewJustOpened = false;
                    nativeReaderOverviewEntryTimer.stop();
                } else {
                    pages.nativeReaderTocReturnsToBook = false;
                }
                // NativeReaderTocActivationEnd
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
    TRAVERSE Background#pages > Loader#tableOfContentsLoader > TableOfContent
        REPLACE onRejected WITH { onRejected: pages.nativeReaderFinishToc() }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/toolbar/qml/AdjustmentToolsMenu.qml
    TRAVERSE ToolbarTool#root
        REPLACE shouldShow WITH { shouldShow: false }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/toolbar/qml/AdjustViewMenu.qml
    TRAVERSE ToolbarTool#root
        REPLACE label WITH { label: "页面缩放" }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/toolbar/qml/SearchButton.qml
    TRAVERSE ToolbarTool#root
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT { shouldShow: false }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/toolbar/qml/ShareMenu.qml
    TRAVERSE ToolbarTool#root
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT { shouldShow: false }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
